description: This file contains a test suite for the InstancesStore component, specifically testing JSON decoding of presence event payloads within the OpenClaw project. It defines a test case that builds a sample payload, processes it via the store, and performs assertions on the resulting instances.

classes.name: InstancesStoreTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating tests for the InstancesStore, particularly verifying JSON decoding and payload handling.

methods.name: presence event payload decodes via JSON encoder
